description: Detect English profanity in text (word list with leetspeak, look-alike letters, repeated letters, dotted/spaced letters and hidden characters handled) and return the matched terms, their positions (UTF-16 start/end in your text) and, unless censor is false, a censored copy of the same length. Common innocent words (Scunthorpe, cockpit, Shiite, cumin) are whitelisted; it does not understand context and is English only. Text up to 10240 UTF-8 bytes; it is not stored or logged. matches is capped at 50 here (match_count is the full total). Read-only. Same engine, keys and limits as POST /v1/check.

allow.description: Words never to flag, e.g. ["hell", "damn"]. Allow wins over deny.

deny.description: Extra words to flag on word boundaries, e.g. ["jerk"].

text.description: The text to check, at most 10240 UTF-8 bytes.

name: check_profanity

censored.description: Your text with each match replaced by asterisks (same length). Omitted when censor is false.

match_count.description: Total number of matches in the text (not capped).

matches.description: Matches in text order, at most 50 here (see match_count for the total). start/end are UTF-16 indices into your text.

truncated.description: True when matches lists fewer than match_count (over 50 here, or the API's own cap).

title: Find and censor English swear words
